scientific_question: What accounts for the relative productive reactivity of the two configurations of substrate S in Pd/L-pyroglutamic-acid C-H olefination, and what can separately defined S/P configurational-interconversion energetics establish about the observed enantioenriched product?

inputs.content: The system is homogeneous Pd-catalyzed C-H olefination of racemic substrate S, an N-(pyridin-2-yl) tribenzo[b,d,f]azepine with one CF3 group, using tert-butyl acrylate A. S connectivity SMILES: N1(c2ncccc2)c2cc(C(F)(F)F)ccc2-c2ccccc2-c2ccccc21. A SMILES: C=CC(=O)OC(C)(C)C. Product P connectivity and alkene geometry SMILES: N1(c2ncccc2)c2cc(C(F)(F)F)ccc2-c2ccccc2-c2cccc(/C=C/C(=O)OC(C)(C)C)c21. The CF3 group is meta to the azepine nitrogen on one outer benzene ring; the E-CH=CH-C(=O)O-tert-butyl group in P is at the nitrogen-adjacent carbon of the opposite outer benzene ring. The nitrogen at the start of each S/P SMILES is the neutral, three-coordinate azepine nitrogen, bonded to the two outer aromatic rings and pyridin-2-yl. S is supplied as the equal mixture of its two mirror-image nitrogen configurations. The SMILES specify connectivity and P's E alkene, not a preferred nitrogen configuration or geometry. Use explicit, consistent stereochemical labels for the two configurations in your investigation. The chiral ligand is L-pyroglutamic acid, (S)-5-oxopyrrolidine-2-carboxylic acid.
Reaction conditions: racemic substrate S 0.1 mmol, tert-butyl acrylate A 4 equiv, Pd(OAc)2 10 mol %, L-pyroglutamic acid 20 mol %, AgNO3 2.0 equiv, CH3CN 2.0 mL, 90 °C, 36 h.
For the model substrate, the reported reaction gave the alkenylated product in 82% isolated yield and 95% ee.

The configurational-interconversion comparisons concern isolated neutral S in acetonitrile at 353.15 K and isolated neutral P in n-octane at 398.15 K. These are separate comparison conditions. The catalytic reaction is in acetonitrile at 363.15 K for 36 h. Do not silently equate the three conditions.

In reaction-progress measurements at 6, 12, 24 and 36 h, isolated P yields were 27%, 41%, 63% and 82%; product ee was 95% and recovered S ee was 0% at each sampled time. In separate tests, isolated P heated in acetonitrile for 2 h at 100, 110, 120 and 130 °C had ee values of 95%, 94%, 92% and 87%, respectively. These measurements are explanatory observations, not calculated rates or barriers.

scope: Model S/A Pd/L-pGlu stereochemical productive-reactivity comparison, and isolated S/1b and P/3ba inversion at their respective source conditions; bounded relation to shared experimental observations.
out_of_scope: Other azepines 4b/5ba/4c and their computed values.
Full catalytic turnover, oxidation/release, coordinated-substrate inversion and quantitative DKR kinetics.
Mandatory prediction of experimental endpoint yield or ee.

paired_modes.paper_reproduction: Same problem and inputs, plus separately disclosed author hypotheses and methods without numerical answers or result ordering.
